hook_lifecycle.provider: deterministic loopback fixture; no semantic quality claim

independent_review.scope: Independent failure reproductions, inbox boundary identity implementation, read-only source-range/catalog/shared-turn/request-schema review

limits: Full coverage applies to eligible safe user/final-assistant text, not tool/thinking/commentary bodies.
Semantic correctness remains probabilistic; these synthetic fixtures are not a general semantic accuracy estimate.
Role slice limits are 1200/2200 characters, not lossy per-native-turn caps. Each batch is at most 24 units/18000 dialogue characters.
Pure receipts are context-sensitive: a compact containing only receipts may use one aggregate call; no per-turn classifier call is introduced.
Long eligible dialogue costs more input tokens than silent truncation; no hardware energy reduction was measured.
Frozen snapshot isolates concurrent work. Other current worktree edits are not implicitly accepted or published.
Isolated CLI Hook acceptance does not establish current desktop embedded rendering or user-chat deployment.
